newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's foreign debt hit $109.3 bln in March.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's foreign debt hit $109.3 bln in March.

text.p: Indonesia's central bank said in its 1996/97 annual report that the country's foreign debt hit $109.3 billion in March.
Indonesia's foreign debt totalled $106.4 billion in the 1995/96 fiscal year ending March.

The bank said government debt totalled $53.3 billion while private debt reached $56.0 billion in the 1996/97 fiscal year, compared with $58.6 billion in government debt and $47.8 billion in private debt in the year-ago period.
It said the decline in government debt was due to the depreciation of the yen against the U.S. dollar and early repayments of foreign debt.
The central bank said increased participation of the private sector in overall economic activity was reflected by rising domestic borrowing from offshore markets.
